description: Simple SOC-voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R_internal

cell.name: Generic NiMH AA cell (positive: NiOOH/Ni(OH)2; negative: AB5 metal hydride)
cell.source: Linden's Handbook of Batteries (4th ed., 2011), ch. 31; Panasonic NiMH datasheets

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial fit: OCV = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative NiMH discharge curve (~1.2 V plateau)
